// diagnostic

E0377

`#Known` is retired.

What

`#Known` is retired.

Why

Compile-time work carries the word `comptime`, and a compile-time constant is `NAME :: comptime { value }`.

Fix

Write `NAME :: comptime { … }` for a constant, `comptime if <condition> { … }` for a compile-time branch, and `comptime { … }` for a compile-time block.
